Part 1 高频 地点 PLACE

Building

建筑

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Are there tall buildings near your home?

Yeah, quite a few, actually. Shenzhen is full of high-rises, so there are lots of tall apartment blocks and office towers near my place. You can see them from almost every street, honestly.

家附近高楼很多，深圳到处是住宅和写字楼，几乎每条街都能看到。

Q2Do you take photos of buildings?

Not really, to be honest. I prefer photographing nature and scenery instead, since buildings just don't interest me that much. I mean, I can appreciate a nice skyline, but I wouldn't stop to take a photo of it.

不怎么拍建筑，更喜欢拍自然风景，虽然能欣赏天际线但不会特意去拍。

Q3Is there a building that you would like to visit?

Not really, honestly. The thing is, I'm actually afraid of heights, so visiting tall landmarks doesn't appeal to me at all. I'd rather stay on the ground and enjoy buildings from street level, you know.

没有特别想参观的楼，因为怕高，宁愿在地面从街边欣赏建筑。

Q4Do you want to live in a tall building?

Definitely not, to be honest. Since I'm afraid of heights, living up on the twentieth floor would make me pretty uncomfortable. I'd much prefer a low-rise apartment, you know, somewhere closer to the ground.

不想住高楼，因为怕高，住二十层会很不舒服，更想住低层公寓。
